system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 3 hours, 20 Spell Uses. Lasts: 24 hours. A portal opens to a furnished countryside cottage with food, drink, a bath and a suspiciously adorable grandma of the caster's race, and closes after 30 seconds. All occupants MUST leave within 24 hours or suffer the consequences; the portal reopens at its original location. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
